plan.capture: CDP Page.startScreencast JPEG quality 85, everyNthFrame=1; no native-full-frame-rate claim
plan.timingBasis: process.hrtime.bigint() receipt time; absolute offsets rounded once to microseconds

interpretation: Reception-time presentation of the image stream actually received. Not exact compositor presentation order, a benchmark, an audience test, or evidence of artistic success. A15 remains failed.
costScope: This complete recording/media worker is separate from the historical TOG subprocess subtotal; neither is total project cost.

captureStart.definition: First actual JPEG arrival in the Node monotonic receipt domain; no pre-arrival interval is encoded.

capture.limitations: Arrival order and Node receipt timing are retained. Transport jitter, queues, receipt workload and capture overhead can alter this rhythm; it is not exact browser presentation timing. CDP may coalesce or omit repaints. Every arrival is acknowledged; native missed frames cannot be counted. Static holds are not assumed dropped frames.

timeline.clockMapping: All receipt, UI brackets, read-only observations and actual stop acknowledgement use process.hrtime.bigint(). Original CDP and epoch values remain diagnostics; phase transitions have read-only polling resolution, not exact transition times.
timeline.quantization: Each BigInt absolute receipt offset from the first arrival is rounded once to microseconds, then differenced for concat duration. JPEG demux, encoder and MP4 track use microsecond time bases. Output -r 60 is nominal only; VFR passthrough and every measured PTS are checked. One repeated terminal image marks real stop, not another captured event. Its packet may extend the file by at most 20ms, with no shortening beyond 2us.
